dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest thoracic section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white, with moderate specular reflection along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density grey mottling is visible along the dorsal midline and the area immediately posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradient between grey mottled regions and the primary light-toned epidermal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Parallel linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the posterior dorsal surface, oriented diagonally toward the right lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of parallel linear rake marks on the posterior dorsal surface.
